R44BB-SURPLUS.corrected_result: Fix constant surplus s>=1. If a width<=3 formula has no R44AT nonexpanding variable, every variable has degree at least five and any minimum-surplus witness V satisfies |V|<=floor(3s/2). Therefore the entire witness V can be eliminated exactly by only O(s) Davis-Putnam eliminations, with polynomial charged work for each fixed s.
R44BB-SURPLUS.nontrivial_content: The structural bounded-witness batch-elimination bound, not the mere existence of one polynomial DP elimination step.
R44BB-SURPLUS.retracted_inference: Do NOT infer that unbounded surplus is necessary for every future irreducible family merely from this theorem. One current-state DP elimination is uniformly polynomial for arbitrary CNF, so fixed-point language based only on existence of a variable-eliminating current step was too weak.

R44BB-AUTOMORPH.result: For fixed occurrence bound D, a polarity-reversing signed automorphism fixing variable identity x is polynomially detectable and certifies SAT(F) iff SAT(F[x=0]).
